prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A good starting point is **American Construction, Inc.** They’re a Joplin general contractor that says it has served the area since 1993 and handles remodeling as well as broader construction work. BBB also lists them among local remodel contractors.

- **Phone:** (417) 781-6811  
- **Address:** 329 N. Main St., Joplin  
- [Company website](https://www.americanconstructionincorporated.com/) · [BBB remodel-contractor listings](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/category/remodel-contractors)

For another option, **GRC General Construction** is listed by BBB for remodeling and general contracting in the Joplin area: **(417) 499-7424**.

Before choosing, get at least three written, itemized bids; ask for recent references for projects like yours; verify insurance and any required permits; and agree on a written scope, schedule, payment milestones, and change-order process. BBB ratings are one screening signal, not a guarantee of workmanship.
